'''Nexufish''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] used in [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Sulyet]] cuisine that could be [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] if not prepared correctly.<ref name="Twilight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nexufish is analogous to the real-world [[Wikipedia:Fugu|fugu]]. They are both fish that are served raw on top of a ball of [[Grain/Legends|grain]], and if not prepared correctly, can kill a person.
